title: FedQCal: Quadratic Programming with Dual-Space Calibration for One-Shot Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One-shot federated learning must combine heterogeneous client models after a single upload. Different local class distributions make it difficult to decide which client updates to retain. We propose FedQCal, which uses a reference model trained on a small labeled server set to define alignment requirements for aggregation. The key idea is to retain sufficient reference alignment while avoiding unnecessarily large aggregation coefficients. A minimum-norm quadratic program (QP) enforces these requirements. Classification loss on the same server examples selects a merge through two dual variables, so the alignment thresholds need not be prescribed in advance. We prove that the selected coefficients remain exact QP solutions at their induced thresholds. A perturbation bound explains how coefficient norm limits the amplification of projection errors. translated_title: FedQCal：面向单轮联邦学习的二次规划与对偶空间校准方法
translated_abstract: 单轮联邦学习需要在客户端仅上传一次后聚合异构的客户端模型。由于各客户端本地类别分布不同，如何决定保留哪些客户端的更新变得十分困难。我们提出FedQCal，该方法利用在服务器端小型标注数据集上训练的参考模型来定义聚合所需满足的对齐要求。其核心思想是在保留充分参考对齐的同时，避免不必要地过大的聚合系数。一个最小范数二次规划（QP）用于强制满足这些要求。在同一批服务器样本上的分类损失通过两个对偶变量来选择合并方案，因此对齐阈值无需事先人为设定。我们证明了所选系数在其诱导阈值处仍然是精确的QP解。一个扰动界解释了系数范数如何限制投影误差的放大。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和SVHN上的实验表明，该方法在大多数设置下均优于单轮FedAvg。
tldr: FedQCal将单轮联邦学习的模型聚合形式化为最小范数二次规划，利用服务器参考模型定义对齐要求，并通过分类损失的两个对偶变量自动校准对齐阈值，无需预先设定阈值即可有效聚合异构客户端模型。
en_tdlr: FedQCal formulates one-shot federated aggregation as a minimum-norm quadratic program with reference-model alignment requirements, and uses dual variables derived from classification loss to automatically calibrate alignment thresholds without pre-specification, outperforming one-round FedAvg in most settings.
